result.mechanism: BK0 constrains its residual to a 1/65535 margin in scene-linear RGB. Near display white, the sRGB OETF compresses that linear margin below half of one 16-bit encoded code, so quantization can still create code 65535. The source-inclusive analytical guard is mathematically cube-safe but its margin is in the wrong domain for the frozen encoded-output gate.
result.claim: BK0 v1 is deterministic and more salient than safe-rich on this population, but it is below the frozen style floor and fails the encoded-boundary gate. Automatic failure forbids visual promotion.

forbidden_followups: change BK0 parameters and rerun on the same population as confirmation
